setting: You are all members of the same Hanoi book club, and you meet at each other's homes or at a café in the city. You have known one another for about two years through the monthly reading group. This month you are choosing the next book and arranging a potluck at Thu's house this weekend.

Ask who can host the potluck

text: Anyone able to host the potluck this sat or sun?
Sat I'm free after 4. Who's cooking what
My place is fine this weekend. Sunday is better, I have a student Saturday morning
Sunday works pharmacy till 12 on sat
Sorry was on the bike all afternoon. Sunday fine
Who's bringing drinks? I can do bia in cans
Boss moved the Q1 review to 7am tomorrow. Great
Oof
Has anyone decided on the next book?
Still voting for the translated one about the fishing village
App dropped 40 orders on me today, lost my whole evening
Ok sunday then. I'll bring something, not sure what yet
Can someone check if the new book is in Fahasa or do I need to order it
Ordered mine already. Arrives thurs
Who actually wants to pick the book, I keep changing my mind
Review done. Still alive
Whoever picks, pick one that's on the Fahasa shelf. Easier for everyone
Fishing village is ok by me. Haven't started it yet
Shift till 6 today
I'll pick then. Decided, no more changing 😂
[photo: four cans of bia in a plastic bag on a bike seat]
Drinks are handled
Good. Fishing village is fine with me. I'll check Fahasa after my lesson
Who's cooking. Thu you have a real stove, I have instant noodles and a rice cooker
I'll make the fish soup. You bring rice
Rice is easy
Can I bring banh gai? My aunt sent a bag from her place. Or is that too much
Bring it. Nobody says no to banh gai
Ordered the book on the app. Blue cover. 2 days
Mine's still coming thurs. Kiet did you get the blue one or the other edition
Fahasa has the blue one on the shelf, I just checked. Not the other edition
Yeah blue one
Rice is in the bag already. 5kg
Get the good one, not the cheap one from the corner
Pharmacy is slammed, half the district has a cold
[photo: stack of delivery bags on a bike seat, rain on the plastic]
Rain again. Hanoi wont let up
Q1 follow up, they want the deck by friday. Fun
Fun is a strong word
Does anyone have a folding table? Two of my chairs are wobbly, I'd rather not put people on those
My sister's folding table from the move is in my car. I'll bring it Sunday
Good, thank you
Last order just came in. Twelve people ordering the same bun cha
Dont ask
Did anyone finish the first chapter yet? I'm on page 9 haha
Chapter 1 is slow. That's fine
Going to sleep
Ok
